policy.identity: exact Unicode/case/whitespace-equivalent team names and a start time within 60 s
policy.exchange: exchange midpoint with both sides two-sided and spread <= 0.1
policy.bookmaker: paired decimal odds with margin in [0.85, 1.35]
policy.model: published rating points only, formula printed per row
policy.never: Hotspawn % picked, HLTV fan votes, inferred values, default 50/50
